guard.note: every reader and writer of lastCapturedImage: captureFrameIfNeeded (one-per-second check, Screenshot.takeScreenshot, replaceLastCapturedImage), saveAndClearCapture, clearLastCapturedImage, replaceLastCapturedImage, clearCaptureState, setCaptureTarget, saveNativeImage
takeScreenshot: new NativeImage(width, height, false), bind the colour texture, downloadTexture(0, true), flipY
downloadTexture: pack alignment, glGetTexImage(GL_TEXTURE_2D, level, RGBA, UNSIGNED_BYTE), the opaque-alpha loop

fancymenu_seamless_capture_async.conversion: @WrapOperation of Screenshot.takeScreenshot in SeamlessWorldLoadingHandler.captureFrameIfNeeded (glGetTexImage into a pixel buffer object + fence, a placeholder image for FancyMenu), @ModifyExpressionValue of its read of lastCapturedImage (the finished image replaces the placeholder), @Inject HEAD of saveAndClearCapture (finish a pending capture) and of clearLastCapturedImage (drop it), and a pixel-address getter on NativeImage; stands aside (FancyMenu's own capture) when another mod's injector handler or overwrite is merged into Screenshot or NativeImage, read once on the first capture; helper bons.furious.patch.fancymenu_capture_c49.SeamlessCapture
fancymenu_seamless_capture_async.license: FancyMenu's licence (DSMSL) allows none of its code: injectors only; the GL read, the copy, the alpha fill and the flip call are our own code or Minecraft's public NativeImage methods
